fullstack.description: A career-focused program that takes you from your first line of HTML to shipping production-ready web apps. Perfect for beginners and career switchers who want to become job-ready Full Stack Developers. You will build real, portfolio-grade projects — dashboards, e-commerce apps, and SaaS tools — and graduate ready for Full Stack, MERN, and Software Engineer roles.

frontend.description: A focused frontend program for aspiring UI engineers who want to build fast, beautiful, and accessible web experiences. You will master modern React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, and ship real responsive apps that look and feel like Vercel, Linear, and Stripe. Ideal for Frontend Developer and UI Engineer roles.

backend.description: An intensive backend program for developers who want to design scalable APIs and services. You will build authentication systems, REST & realtime APIs, and production-ready backends with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Ideal for Backend, API, and Node.js Developer roles.

cyber.description: A hands-on Cyber Security program covering ethical hacking, penetration testing, and SOC workflows. You will work inside real vulnerable labs, learn attacker and defender mindsets, and prepare for high-demand roles in Security Analysis, Pen Testing, and SOC.

ai.description: A modern AI & Machine Learning program for developers ready to ship real ML and LLM-powered products. You will train models with PyTorch, build RAG apps with LangChain, and deploy AI features to production. Ideal for ML Engineer, AI Engineer, and Applied Scientist roles.

devops.description: A practical DevOps program that turns you into the engineer teams rely on to ship reliably. You will automate CI/CD pipelines, containerise apps with Docker, orchestrate with Kubernetes, and manage infrastructure with Terraform on AWS. Ideal for DevOps Engineer, SRE, and Platform Engineer roles.
